insights.title: Rain coming: delay spraying
insights.action: Rain expected from 26 Nov: delay spraying and harvesting on rainy days.
insights.message: Rain expected on 2026-11-26. Delay field work such as spraying or harvesting on those days.
insights.basis: Rain of 1 mm or more is forecast on Thu 26 Nov, Sun 29 Nov, within the next 3 days. Spraying or harvesting just before rain is usually wasted effort. This is Imarika's own rule, not an official standard.
insights.caveat: Rainfall forecasts are less reliable than temperature forecasts.

scenarios.title: Planting rains
scenarios.what_to_do: Rain from 27 Nov may suit planting. Dry spells beyond 7 days are not checked.

insights.title: Good rain for planting
insights.action: Rain from 27 Nov may suit planting. Dry spells beyond 7 days are not checked.
insights.message: Planting window: 23.0 mm of rain expected from 2026-11-27 to 2026-12-01, with 4 rain days. Dry-spell risk beyond the 7-day forecast horizon is not assessed.
insights.basis: About 23 mm of rain is forecast over the 5 days from Fri 27 Nov to Tue 1 Dec, with rain on 4 of them. Imarika counts at least 20 mm over 5 days, with rain on at least 3 days, as good rain for planting, following published definitions of the start of the rains. It cannot check for dry spells after the 7-day forecast.
insights.caveat: Rainfall forecasts are less reliable than temperature forecasts.

insights.title: Very heavy rain
insights.action: Flood warning 28 Nov: very heavy rain expected. If you are in a flood-prone area, move to higher ground.
insights.message: Flood warning: very heavy rain of 62.0 mm expected on 2026-11-28.
insights.basis: The forecast shows 62 mm of rain on Sat 28 Nov. Imarika raises a very heavy rain alert when one day's rain reaches 50 mm, the level the Kenya Meteorological Department describes as very heavy rainfall.
insights.caveat: Rainfall forecasts are less reliable than temperature forecasts.
